records.source: Have you met everyone in town yet? That sounds exhausting.
records.translation: 你已經見過鎮上每個人了嗎？聽起來真累人。

records.source: Wow, look at these structures!$h#$b#I can tell they were made by a master builder. I'm really impressed!
records.translation: 哇，看看這些建築！$h#$b#我看得出來，它們出自建築大師之手。真讓我佩服！

records.source: Wait a sec... you're giving me this? What a special treat! Thank you.
records.translation: 等一下……你要把這個送給我？真是特別的享受！謝謝。

records.source: What's this... 'Woody's Secret'? ... Um, what kind of book is this, @?$6#$b#Oh, it's about woodcutting! Hahaha... Oh yeah, I'm going to love this. Thanks!$4
records.translation: 這是什麼……《伍迪的祕密》？……呃，這是什麼類型的書，@？$6#$b#喔，是講伐木的！哈哈哈……喔，沒錯，我一定會喜歡。謝謝！$4

records.source: Ah, 'Woodcutter's Weekly'... I was hoping to get my hands on the newest issue! They've got all the latest techniques in here!#$b#From one woodcutter to another... Thank you.$h
records.translation: 啊，《伐木工週刊》……我一直希望能拿到最新一期！裡面有所有最新技術！#$b#同為伐木工……謝謝你。$h

records.source: That man is insane! Why does he have to go out there? We have no idea if this rain is dangerous!$u%noturn
records.translation: 那個男人瘋了！為什麼非得跑出去？我們根本不知道這場雨危不危險！$u%noturn

records.source: I hope Demetrius is happy with the 'samples' he collected. Seems like his little science project is more important to him than his own wife. Hmmph.$6
records.translation: 希望德米特里厄斯對收集到的「樣本」感到滿意。看來他那小小的科學計畫比自己的妻子更重要。哼。$6

records.source: There's all kinds of good wood out there today. Better get chopping, huh?
records.translation: 今天外面到處都是好木材。最好趕快去砍，對吧？

records.source: Sebastian's back in the basement... what happened between you two?$s
records.translation: 賽巴斯汀搬回地下室了……你們之間發生了什麼？$s

records.source: Maru was crying through the night... We're all devastated...$s
records.translation: 瑪魯哭了一整晚……我們全都非常難過……$s

records.source: Oh, don't worry... these are tears of joy. I know Sebastian will be very happy on %farm Farm!$h
records.translation: 喔，別擔心……這是喜悅的眼淚。我知道賽巴斯汀會在%farm農場過得很幸福！$h

records.source: We'll all miss having Maru around the house, but I'm sure we'll still see her often!
records.translation: 我們都會想念瑪魯在家裡的日子，但我相信還是能常見到她！

records.source: It was fun working on your house. That might be some of the finest construction I've ever done!$h#$e#I hope you're enjoying the new kitchen.
records.translation: 替你改造房屋很有趣。這也許是我做過最精良的工程之一！$h#$e#希望你喜歡新廚房。

records.source: What are you going to do with all that new space in your house?#$e#Or perhaps I should call it... your 'mansion'?$h
records.translation: 你打算怎麼利用房屋裡新增的那麼多空間？#$e#也許我該稱它為……你的「豪宅」？$h

records.source: So, are you getting into the aged wine business? I've heard it's very lucrative... if you have the patience.
records.translation: 所以，你要開始做熟成果酒的生意嗎？我聽說利潤非常高……只要你有耐心。

records.source: That's probably the sturdiest coop I've ever built. Hope you get a lot of use out of it!
records.translation: 那大概是我建過最堅固的雞舍。希望你能充分利用！

records.source: So, what are your plans with the new shed? The possibilities are endless!
records.translation: 所以，你打算怎麼利用新工坊？可能性無窮無盡！

records.source: How's that new coop treatin' ya? I'll be excited to meet your new animals!
records.translation: 新雞舍用得怎麼樣？我很期待見到你的新動物！

records.source: Are you satisfied with the new barn? I'm sure you'll raise some very happy livestock in there!
records.translation: 你對新畜棚滿意嗎？我相信你會在裡面養出非常快樂的牲畜！

records.source: *phew*... Building that slime hutch was a lot of work... I'll need a day at the spa to recuperate!$h
records.translation: *呼*……建造那座史萊姆屋真費功夫……我得去水療中心休養一天！$h

records.source: So, have you been riding your new horse around town?#$b#I imagine you're pretty sore, but you'll get used to it soon.$h
records.translation: 所以，你騎著新馬在鎮上到處跑了嗎？#$b#我猜你的身體很痠痛，不過很快就會習慣。$h

records.source: I mentioned to Willy that you got a new fish pond. He seemed really happy about it.#$e#Apparently, he raised crabs when he was a young man. Called it a 'time-honored tradition'.$h
records.translation: 我向威利提到你有了新魚塘。他看起來很高興。#$e#原來他年輕時養過螃蟹，還稱那是「歷史悠久的傳統」。$h

records.source: That was fun!$h
records.translation: 真好玩！$h

records.source: Hey, look! I can see another island from here.
records.translation: 嘿，快看！從這裡能看見另一座島。

records.source: Hey @. You know, I was just thinking about how far the town has come since you first moved here.#$b#You should really be proud of all you've done!$h
records.translation: 嘿，@。你知道嗎，我剛才在想，自從你搬來後，這座城鎮有了多麼大的進步。#$b#你真的應該為自己做到的一切感到驕傲！$h

records.source: This is so relaxing...
records.translation: 真讓人放鬆……

records.source: Veggie salt? Sounds good, but I don't need it.
records.translation: 蔬菜鹽？聽起來不錯，但我不需要。

records.source: Hmm... when I think of flowers, I think of Evelyn. Maybe show this to her?
records.translation: 嗯……想到花，我就會想到伊芙琳。也許拿給她看看？

records.source: Our little plan worked out well, don't you think? Pam and Penny seem really happy.
records.translation: 我們的小計畫進行得很順利，你不覺得嗎？潘姆和潘妮看起來都很開心。

records.source: Our little plan worked out well, don't you think? Pam and Penny seem really happy.
records.translation: 我們的小計畫進行得很順利，你不覺得嗎？潘姆和潘妮看起來都很開心。

records.source: Ooh... Two tickets for tonight's show, huh? Sounds good! I'll meet you there.$h
records.translation: 喔……今晚電影的兩張票，對吧？聽起來不錯！到時候見。$h

records.source: Hey! I heard some weird noises last night, and woke up this morning to find the quarry bridge completely repaired!#$b#It's a miracle of woodworking!
records.translation: 嘿！昨晚我聽到一些怪聲，今天早上醒來就發現採石場的橋完全修好了！#$b#這是木工奇蹟！

records.source: I knew it from the moment you stepped off that bus, @... you were destined to be a town hero!$h
records.translation: 從你踏下公車的那一刻起，我就知道了，@……你注定會成為城鎮英雄！$h

records.source: Hey! I heard that Lewis showed you around the Community Center... It'd be great if you could fix that place up. It used to be a really nice building!
records.translation: 嘿！我聽說路易斯鎮長帶你參觀了社區中心……如果你能修好那裡就太棒了。以前那棟建築很漂亮！

records.source: Have I told you that I built our house from the ground up?#$e#It's definitely been the highlight of my career so far.
records.translation: 我告訴過你，我們的房子是我從零開始建造的嗎？#$e#這絕對是我目前職業生涯中最傑出的成就。

records.source: Hey, if you need any materials or blueprints, my shop is the place you're looking for!#$e#Plus, your business supports the local economy.$h
records.translation: 嘿，如果需要材料或設計圖，我的店就是你要找的地方！#$e#而且你的消費還能支持本地經濟。$h

records.source: Hey there, @.#$e#I was just daydreaming about some new carpentry projects.#$e#Are you doing OK at your place? How's the woodwork in your cottage holding up?
records.translation: 嘿，@。#$e#我剛才正在幻想一些新的木工計畫。#$e#你家一切都好嗎？小屋裡的木製結構還牢固嗎？

records.source: You're always welcome to visit us, even if you aren't shopping, you know.$h#$e#It can get pretty lonely up here in the mountains.
records.translation: 即使不買東西，也隨時歡迎來看我們。$h#$e#住在山上有時很寂寞。

records.source: You've met my son Sebastian, right? He lives downstairs.#$e#He's a little shy, but I'm sure he'll warm up to you if you're nice to him.
records.translation: 你見過我兒子賽巴斯汀了，對吧？他住在樓下。#$e#他有點害羞，但只要對他友善，我相信他會慢慢接受你。

records.source: I miss my Sebby... he was always a little misunderstood, but I believed in him.
records.translation: 我想念我的小賽巴斯汀……他總是有點不被理解，但我一直相信他。

records.source: #$1 RobinSeb#I found an ashtray in Sebastian's room, and it smelled really weird. Should I be worried about this?#$e#Sometimes I worry about Sebastian... he doesn't have many friends and doesn't really seem to care about his future very much...#$e#I would talk to him about it but he never opens up to me.
records.translation: #$1 RobinSeb#我在賽巴斯汀房裡找到一個菸灰缸，聞起來很奇怪。我該擔心嗎？#$e#有時我很擔心賽巴斯汀……他的朋友不多，看起來也不太在乎自己的未來……#$e#我想和他談談，但他從不對我敞開心扉。

records.source: Sebastian told me he's trying to quit smoking! I'm really proud of him.
records.translation: 賽巴斯汀告訴我他正在努力戒菸！我真的為他驕傲。

records.source: Our house is in such a beautiful area, don't you think?#$e#I love the fresh air of the mountains.
records.translation: 我們的房子坐落在這麼美麗的地方，你不覺得嗎？#$e#我喜歡山間的新鮮空氣。

records.source: I hope Demetrius doesn't blow the house up with those science experiments of his.#$e#I'm not even sure what he's working on. I think it has something to do with plants.
records.translation: 希望德米特里厄斯不會用那些科學實驗炸掉房子。#$e#我甚至不確定他在研究什麼。我想和植物有關。

records.source: #$1 RobinDem#My husband almost set the house on fire last night with his science experiment. One of his beakers exploded and sent a fireball into the rafters! Thank Yoba I used fire-resistant lacquer when I built the place.$u#$e#Sorry if it smells weird in here, @. It's my husband's bizarre science project...
records.translation: #$1 RobinDem#昨晚我丈夫的科學實驗差點把房子燒掉。一只燒杯爆炸，把火球射進了屋頂椽木！幸好尤巴保佑，我建造房子時使用了防火漆。$u#$e#抱歉這裡聞起來很奇怪，@。是我丈夫那個古怪的科學計畫……

records.source: Hi @! It's good to see you.#$e#You're a regular member of the community now, don't you think?
records.translation: 嗨，@！很高興見到你。#$e#你現在已經是社區裡的老成員了，對吧？

records.source: Great, then this blueprint should be a piece of cake for you!$h
records.translation: 太好了，那這份設計圖對你來說應該輕而易舉！$h

records.source: Well, then I have the perfect blueprint to get you started!
records.translation: 嗯，那我有一份最適合讓你入門的設計圖！

records.source: Wood is a wonderful substance... it's versatile, cheap, strong, and each piece has its own unique character!
records.translation: 木材是很奇妙的材料……用途廣泛、價格便宜又堅固，而且每一塊都有自己的獨特性格！

records.source: If you need any buildings on your farm upgraded, just ask me!#$e#You'll need to provide enough lumber and stone for the project. And it costs money, too.#$e#But I'm sure you'll be pleased with the results!$h
records.translation: 如果需要升級農場上的任何建築，只管找我！#$e#你必須為工程提供足夠的木材和石頭，另外也得付錢。#$e#不過我相信你一定會滿意成果！$h

records.source: We're pretty insulated from the rest of the world here in Stardew Valley.#$e#It has its pros and cons.
records.translation: 星露谷和外界相當隔絕。#$e#這有好處，也有壞處。

records.source: #$1 RobinMaru#Maru likes gems. She uses them in her inventions.#$e#So how are you and Maru getting along?
records.translation: #$1 RobinMaru#瑪魯喜歡寶石。她會把寶石用在發明中。#$e#所以，你和瑪魯相處得怎麼樣？

records.source: You're always welcome to visit us, even if you aren't in the market for a building upgrade!$h#$e#It can get pretty lonely up here in the mountains.
records.translation: 即使不打算升級建築，也隨時歡迎來看我們！$h#$e#住在山上有時很寂寞。

records.source: Have you met the wild man that lives behind our house?$s#$e#I guess I don't really mind, as long as he doesn't bother us.
records.translation: 你見過住在我家後面的野人嗎？$s#$e#只要他不打擾我們，我想自己其實不介意。

records.source: Hey, it's a perfect time of year to gather wood.#$e#Maybe you can collect enough to upgrade your house!
records.translation: 嘿，這是一年中最適合收集木材的時候。#$e#也許你能收集到足夠木材來升級房屋！

records.source: My parents were bewildered when I told them I wanted to be a carpenter.#$e#They were pretty old-fashioned.
records.translation: 我告訴父母想當木匠時，他們非常困惑。#$e#他們相當守舊。

records.source: I think the farm life is really healthy for Sebby.
records.translation: 我覺得農場生活對小賽巴斯汀真的很健康。

records.source: Our house is in such a beautiful area, don't you think?#$e#Everything looks still after a fresh snow.
records.translation: 我們的房子坐落在這麼美麗的地方，你不覺得嗎？#$e#新雪過後，一切看起來都靜止了。
